history.fact: Ernest Raymond Gantt is born Feb 22. The 1910 census puts him in Limestone County, Texas. Other sources say New Orleans.
Don's Beachcomber opens in Hollywood. Some sources say 1934.
It moves across the street, grows into a restaurant with Polynesian decor and becomes Don the Beachcomber.
Sunny Sund has run the business while he serves in the Army Air Forces. He signs control over to her and agrees not to open a Don the Beachcomber anywhere in the United States.
He opens his own Don the Beachcomber in Waikiki. Dates vary by source.
Trader Vic's 1944 mai tai is first poured in Hawaii, at the Royal Hawaiian.
His Waikiki Village opens under a banyan with the Dagger Bar, per the plaque that still hangs there. Some sources say 1957.
He dies in Honolulu on June 7 and is buried at Punchbowl, the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific.
The Royal Kona Resort buys the Hawaii rights to the Don the Beachcomber name.
International Market Place reopens Aug 25 around the surviving banyan, with a tribute treehouse.

mai_tai: Who made the first mai tai is still argued. Trader Vic is reported to have mixed it in Oakland in 1944. Donn Beach called it a copy of his Q.B. Cooler.

tiki-bars.name: International Market Place, Don's Treehouse tribute
tiki-bars.blurb: The banyan Donn Beach built his Waikiki village around still stands, with a tribute treehouse and a plaque. It's a mall now, so come for the tree and the plaque, not a drink.
tiki-bars.order: The banyan, the tribute treehouse and the plaque for the 1956 Dagger Bar and Bazaar Buildings
tiki-bars.age: A mall. A pilgrimage stop, not a bar

tiki-bars.name: La Mariana Sailing Club
tiki-bars.address: 50 Sand Island Access Rd., Honolulu, HI 96819
tiki-bars.blurb: A 1950s tiki room on Sand Island, open since 1957. The rattan chairs came out of Don the Beachcomber's, and the lamps are blowfish.
tiki-bars.check: Open Tuesday to Saturday only. Call first.
tiki-bars.order: Mai tai or Zombie, under Trader Vic's blowfish lamps and tikis from the Sheraton's Kon Tiki Room
tiki-bars.hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.

tiki-bars.name: Mai Tai Bar, The Royal Hawaiian
tiki-bars.short: Mai Tai Bar, The Royal Hawaiian
tiki-bars.blurb: Beachfront at the Royal Hawaiian, where Trader Vic's mai tai was first poured in Hawaii in 1953. Order the Royal Mai Tai.
tiki-bars.order: Royal Mai Tai, or the 1944 Trader Vic's Mai Tai
tiki-bars.hours: Cocktails 10:30 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily. Live music 6 to 10 p.m.
tiki-bars.age: Busy and family-heavy by day. Go after dark for the music and a calmer crowd

tiki-bars.name: House Without A Key (Halekulani)
tiki-bars.blurb: Sunset under the old kiawe tree at the Halekulani, with Hawaiian music and hula every night.
tiki-bars.hours: Hawaiian music 5:30 to 8:30 p.m. nightly, hula 6:30 to 8:30

tiki-bars.name: Hau Tree Bar, Hilton Hawaiian Village
tiki-bars.short: Hau Tree Bar, Hilton Hawaiian Village
tiki-bars.blurb: Beach bar at the Hilton Hawaiian Village, where Harry Yee is credited with the Blue Hawaii. Some of his credits are disputed.
tiki-bars.hours: 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., Friday and Saturday to 9
tiki-bars.age: Next to the resort's big pool, so family-heavy. Closes early

tiki-bars.name: Skull & Crown Trading Co.
tiki-bars.blurb: A small Chinatown tiki bar from 2019. The house drink arrives on fire in a ceramic skull, made for two.
tiki-bars.check: Tuesday to Saturday, 5 to 11 p.m. Holiday-week hours not posted.
tiki-bars.order: The Skull & Crown for two, the Maunakea Mai Tai or a Lapu Lapu

tiki-bars.name: Tiki's Grill & Bar
tiki-bars.address: 2570 Kalakaua Ave., 2nd floor, The Twin Fin hotel, Honolulu, HI 96815
tiki-bars.blurb: Second-floor Waikiki tiki bar in the Twin Fin hotel, with a speakeasy tucked inside.
tiki-bars.check: Its Christmas Bar pop-up ran through Dec 30 the last three years. 2026 isn't announced.
tiki-bars.order: 1944 Mai Tai. The Lava Lounge speakeasy books separately

tiki-bars.name: Arnold's Beach Bar & Grill
tiki-bars.blurb: A Waikiki dive with carved tikis and a cheap mai tai.
tiki-bars.check: Check the street number on the map before you go.

tiki-bars.name: Heyday at White Sands Hotel (Green Lady bar)
tiki-bars.blurb: Mid-century Waikiki hotel bar pouring the 1944-style mai tai. A good-looking room, not a historic one.

tiki-bars.name: South Shore Tiki Lounge
tiki-bars.blurb: Kihei's tiki lounge, with an all-day happy hour and live music.
tiki-bars.check: Founding year unknown, and no tie to Donn Beach.
tiki-bars.hours: Kitchen 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Happy hour 11 to 6. Live music daily
tiki-bars.age: A party bar, most adult late on DJ nights

tiki-bars.name: Don the Beachcomber Restaurant & Don's Mai Tai Bar, Royal Kona Resort
tiki-bars.blurb: Oceanfront in Kailua-Kona with ten mai tai versions. The Don the Beachcomber name came with Hawaii rights the resort bought in 2005, not from Donn Beach.
tiki-bars.check: One report says the restaurant side is closed until late 2027. The bar lists daily hours. Call 808-329-3111.
tiki-bars.hours: Bar 6:30 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. daily. Happy hour 4 to 6. Live Hawaiian music Thursdays 5 to 7

tiki-bars.name: Tahiti Nui
tiki-bars.blurb: Hanalei's tiki bar since 1963, still run by the founding family, with live Hawaiian music every night.
tiki-bars.order: The house mai tai, a secret recipe since opening
tiki-bars.hours: Opens 11 a.m. daily, with live music every night

events.name: The Christmas Bar Hawaii pop-up
events.venue: Tiki's Grill & Bar, Twin Fin hotel, Waikiki
events.status: It ran through Dec 30 the last three years. 2026 isn't announced
